notes: No article morpheme stands in חֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה here, so the single written 'the' is supplied on the construct under rule 29; contrast JOS.22.7/9/10/11/21, where MACULA segments an article on Manasseh and that morpheme takes the written 'the'.
All three לְ tokens (s004, s008, s012) are unrepresented alike: the ASV writes bare objects after 'called'.
